audit.whatIsWrong: Four fields give Shen one of Kassadin's own abilities. early: 'he can Shadow Dash (E) onto you, taunt, and Nether Blade-empower an auto'. whys[0]: 'his Shadow Dash plus a Nether Blade-empowered auto'. spikes[0]: 'taunts, and Nether Blade-empowers an auto'. wants.foe[0]: 'then Nether Blade-empower an auto'. Nether Blade is Kassadin's W. Shen's empowered attack is Twilight Assault (Q), which Riot describes as 'dealing damage based on the target's max health'. Separately, the biggest lever Kassadin has against Shen is nowhere on the page: Stand United is a channel, and Riot's Null Sphere text is 'dealing damage and interrupting channels' — so a Q on the wind-up cancels his global save outright.
audit.why: Naming your own W as the enemy's damage source is the kind of error that survives because it reads fluently. And a Shen page that lists Stand United purely as something you cannot contest is leaving the one counter unstated.
audit.corrected: Twilight Assault (Q) and its max-health damage replace 'Nether Blade' in all four fields. The Null Sphere interrupt on Stand United is now in late, spikes[3], whys[6], wants.you[2], breakdown.cooldowns and loading.

edits.before: This is where the 45% bites: even fully scaled you don't win the 1v1. Your ramped Riftwalk burst blanks off Shen's raw HP, and his point-and-click taunt catches you mid-blink and holds you long enough for his team to collapse — exactly the hard lockdown your squishy kit dreads. Meanwhile Stand United (R) lets him impact every other lane while you're stuck side-laning. Your realistic win condition is to use your blink to pick squishies in teamfights and split around him — never to try to kill the Shen himself.

notes: Calibration-grade error found here: four fields credited Shen with 'Nether Blade', which is Kassadin's own W. His empowered attack is Twilight Assault (Q), max-health damage. The packet's suspectNames list for this matchup flagged 'Spirit's Refuge' and 'Nether Blade's' as near-misses — both are real ability names spelled correctly, so those three suspect rows are false positives; the actual error was attribution, not spelling. Left alone: report[6].t still says 'Fleet plus Q shield is how you survive the bully phase'. Riot's text does not state a damage type for Twilight Assault or Shadow Dash, so I could not verify whether the magic-only Q shield helps against Shen and did not rewrite that line. Standing kit-flag misfire noted in the other files applies here too — _missing-interactions.json's 'Shen can cancel your Null Sphere (Q) with Shadow Dash (E)' is built on a bad channel flag and is not on the page.
